candidates.topic: Audit committee oversight independence and governance
candidates.rationale: Already has a rich, detailed scenario (SignalPoint Technologies with multiple governance red flags). Mislabeled as Understand - the prompt already requires evaluating multiple deficiencies and determining which is most critical under COSO Principle 4.

The external auditor has communicated a significant deficiency in revenue recognition controls for two consecutive years without remediation. Which governance deficiency is most apparent?
